CATCH F1 (MASS -- forecloses the GLOBAL-DISSOLVE headline).
  The proved cubic coherence lives ENTIRELY on the c=0 slice: T(a0,b)=U(a0,b,0),
  and the coherence dephases off c=0 (a collinear zero-sum triple lies on a
  line y=lambda x + nu; at c=0 the intercept nu drops out and x1+x2+x3=lambda^2
  is a square so chi2(x-sum)=+1 universally; for c!=0 the y-sum carries nu and
  the triples dephase). The c=0 slice is p of the p^2 frequencies. Per-c the
  energy is ~uniform (Sum_b|U(b,c)|^2 ~ p(n-1) for every c), so the slice
  carries ~1/p of the global L1 mass. A bounded (<=100%) slice deficit
  therefore contributes at most ~(slice deficit)/p to the GLOBAL deficit
  fraction. At p=2089 that ceiling is <= (few%)/2089 ~ 1e-5 vs the global
  1e-3: the cubic coherence can account for AT MOST ~1-2% of the GLOBAL
  deficit, a ceiling that FALLS as 1/p while the global deficit is PERSISTENT.
  => The headline OUTCOME-DISSOLVE **for the global deficit** is FORECLOSED
     pre-run, by algebra, at every prime in scope. Combined with the already-
     refuted M4/quadruple route, the two known coherence structures both fail
     to carry the global deficit. This test is therefore REFRAMED to the ONLY
     object the proved coherence can speak to: the c=0 SLICE's own deficit.

CATCH F2 (MAGNITUDE-NEUTRALITY -- keeps the SLICE test non-forced/live).
  |Sum_b chi2(b)T^3| = sqrt(p)*n^2, whereas the generic third-moment scale is
  M3 = Sum_b|T(b)|^3 ~ 1.33*p*n^{1.5}. The ratio (coherence bound)/(typical M3)
  = sqrt(n/p)/1.33 ~ 0.75 < 1, i.e. the proved coherence does NOT force an
  anomalous magnitude M3 and hence does NOT, by any inequality, force a slice

  magnitude. => whether it couples to the slice L1 deficit is genuinely OPEN

Fix p == 1 mod 6 with E(F_p) CYCLIC of order n = #E(F_p); G the canonical
generator (rule inherited from the established experiment); P_d = [d]G,
d=1..n-1, exhaust the non-identity group; a0 = 1. x_d, y_d = affine coords of
P_d (exact int curve arithmetic). e_p(k)=e^{2 pi i k/p}, zeta_n=e^{2 pi i/n},
chi2 = Legendre symbol mod p, tau = Sum_{t=1}^{p-1} chi2(t) e_p(t) the
quadratic Gauss sum (tau=sqrt(p) if p==1 mod 4, tau=i*sqrt(p) if p==3 mod 4),
u = tau/|tau| in {1, i}.

  c=0 SLICE:  T(b) := U(a0,b,0) = Sum_{d=1}^{n-1} zeta_n^{a0 d} e_p(b x_d),

  Proved coherence:         C_char = Sum_{b=1}^{p-1} chi2(b) T(b)^3   ( ~ tau*n^2 ).

THE OBJECT MEASURED: whether the multiset { |T(b)| : b=1..p-1 } is sub-Rayleigh
(an L1 deficit at the pinned L2 = E) BEYOND what is forced by the character's
Hermitian symmetry and its proved cubic coherence C_char. This is a joint

The primary's null IS the matched control (the B ensemble). Two auxiliary
nulls calibrate it and separate causes; all draws are Hermitian-paired.

No verdict is issued unless P-EXACT, P-DIR, P-COH, CAL-OVER, CAL-UNDER all pass.

   If it fails at a prime (should not, C is proved), EXCLUDE that prime and

 CAL-UNDER (B is correctly centered): draw a FRESH magnitude vector FROM B and

 CAL-BINDS (the coherence constraint is not inert): report Delta_coh =

OUTPUT TYPE, pre-committed: a characterization plus bounds, each carrying its
power number and the Sec.6 scope, plus the standing H0 statement. NEVER a
